Kenji / Eleanor — answering briefly here ahead of the walkthrough and attaching the draft mapping. Full notes for the session will be circulated after.

1) Access logs: our CloudTrail-style extracts include full request metadata (timestamp, service, operation, requestURI, principalIdentifier). We can generate a scoped extract with full URIs and principals — no automated redaction unless requested.

2) Key rotation: policy summary below (we will add the formal policy doc to the Drive link):
   - Rotation frequency: customer-service keys rotated every 90 days; platform operational keys rotated annually; automated enforcement via KMS lifecycle policy and rotation workflow in our secrets service.
   - Enforcement: rotation jobs are scheduled and failures surface to our PagerDuty runbook for manual remediation.

3) Retention + ad-hoc extracts: we can produce extracts beyond 180 days on request. Standard SLA: 3–7 business days depending on size; signed statement can be provided (we will include a short letter of commitment in the Drive link).

Next steps:
- Kimberly to publish Drive link with read-only access for OrionTech (sig_control_mapping.xlsx, system_architecture_diagram.pdf, policy-summary.txt).
- Schedule 30-min walkthrough: Thursday 2028-06-22 at 10am PT (tentative).
- Action owners copied above.

Thanks — look forward to the call.

Best,
